enumDescriptions: Ask once per workspace before writing Lua.* settings for the Lua language server (sumneko.lua).
Always configure the Lua language server in workspaces with content packs, without asking.
Never change Lua.* settings automatically (the commands still work).
voxelcore.configureLua.markdownDescription: Whether VoxelCore Tools configures the [Lua language server](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=sumneko.lua) for content-pack workspaces: adds the engine API definitions to `Lua.workspace.library`, sets `Lua.runtime.version` to `LuaJIT`, and registers engine globals in `Lua.diagnostics.globals`.
